presets.coordinatorDecision: Standing coordinator rule (AUTHORING item 20). TRUE DRIVER: at 1:1 two complete rooms side by side plus one shared panel cannot hold four participants, five numbered items (their texts drawn once in the panel), two exhibits, three near-maximum shared facts and near-maximum comparison labels: the panel overflowed the frame (panel-overflow) at 16.4 px. Tried before capping: rooms side by side with a band panel (2 and 3 columns) and stacked with a column panel (0.30-0.42); room width search; headers with and without the caption; card texts on the cards (rooms too small, people 46 px) and numbered cards with texts in the panel; shorter item texts and labels alone (panel still overflowing); 4 items (panel still overflowing). Rendered BEFORE (capmeasure, hold): 16:9 16.4 px / 67.6 px, 9:16 17.1 / 68.5 (subject-short), 1:1 16.4 / 51.7 (panel-overflow). AFTER the cap (3 participants, 3 items, 1 shared fact of 65 characters; labels 38-41 and items 34-42 characters): 16:9 19.8 / 65.2, 9:16 16.4 / 77.8, 1:1 16.4 / 58.3. Counts equal the baseline (3 participants, 3 items, 1 shared fact) and stay >= it; every capped field is longer than its baseline; scenario captions and comparison labels keep near-maximum lengths. Pre-cap preset: production/scratch/hearings-02/LAW-0287.presets.precap.json.
